title: Overriding definition such as type alias in a subclass causes a crash

labels.name: topic-type-alias
labels.description: TypeAlias and other type alias issues

body:
The following program crashes on both mypy 0.620 and the latest version on master:

```python
from typing import Any, Callable

class Parent:
    foo = Callable[..., int] 

class Child(Parent):
    def foo(self, val: int) -> int:
        return val * 2
```

(In this case, I meant to do `foo: Callable[..., int]`.)
